duration: Senior year, follows the college calendar
pay_detail: Free. No tuition for the college classes.
name: Career Prep at Mercer County Community College
what_you_do: As a senior, take free college classes at Mercer County Community College for dual credit. Choices include aviation, criminal justice, culinary arts, digital film, IT, pre-engineering and more.
who_can_apply: Rising seniors with at least a 3.2 GPA and 95 percent attendance. Students in the MCTS Academy or Shared-Time programs cannot apply.
deadline_text: The career prep page links to an application but does not state open or closing dates. Ask admissions@mcts.edu for the 2027-2028 dates.
how_to_apply: Create an account in the MCTS online application portal and apply. Your counselor then uploads transcripts and attendance. Email admissions@mcts.edu with questions.
notes: You become a regular college student with a MyMercer account. Most classes are on the West Windsor campus. Mercer County residency is not spelled out on the page, so ask admissions. The Aviation section says that by continuing this program, costs could range from $24,000 to $36,000. The page does not say what that covers.
